profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Trane Technologies
profile.summary:
My very diverse background in technical areas as well as roles demonstrates the strong problem solving skills that are required of a good technical programmer.  I'm a highly motivated manager, programmer, technical lead, and effective communicator.  My focus is on getting the right solution out the door in a maintainable, manageable, timely manner.  I don't sacrifice quality in regards to testing, documentation, training and have always focused on helping to find and provide the right tools to get it done.  My strengths are magnified when working in a team setting that is open to brainstorming, test driven development.

Specialties: 
Languages: 	Java, JavaScript, Ruby, Python, Angular, Postgres, MongoDB, Flash, PICK, C#, TCL, C++, C, TSQL, XML, Visual Basic
Tools:		Git, Jenkins, Bitbucket, Gradle, Node.js, Spring, Postman, Wireshark, vCenter, vCloud, VMWare, JSON, REST, SOAP, NVM, Confluence, Hudson, Continuum, ANT, Maven, UML, MTS, RDS, ODBC
Software: 	IntelliJ IDEA, Eclipse IDE, WebStorm, Perforce, SCRUMWorks, Jira, VersionOne, Rational Rose, Clear Case, Clear Quest, Microsoft Visual Studio, Rational Purify, Rational Quantify, Microsoft VSS, Microsoft Message Queue, RDS, Microsoft Project
